thread.title: How Much Will Apple Increase Its Capital Return Program?

author: PATRICK SEITZ
title: How Much Will Apple Increase Its Capital Return Program?
text:
Apple ( AAPL ) is expected to update its capital return program soon and one Wall Street analyst thinks it will announce a massive increase in share repurchases and cash dividends.
X Citi Research analyst Jim Suva on Thursday predicted the tech behemoth will raise its capital return program to about $400 billion from its current $300 billion. The $100 billion increase would be double the amount the company has added in each of the previous two years, CNBC reported .
Apple will be able to increase its capital return program thanks to corporate tax reforms championed by President Donald Trump. Under the new provisions, it is expected repatriate most of its foreign profits.
Apple shares have been consolidating a few weeks. The stock hit an all-time high of 183.50 on March 13 before the recent market correction. Shares are trying to climb back above the 50-day moving average, where they've found resistance over the past two weeks.

Earnings Report Due Apple is set to announce changes to its capital return program when it releases fiscal second-quarter results on May 1.
"We do expect volatility ahead as consensus estimates calibrate to lower March and June quarters given more tempered demand for iPhone X," Suva said in a note to clients. "Looking ahead, we expect investor focus to be on the impact from Apple's capital returns strategy, which we estimate could be a $100 billion increase, the second-half 2018 (iPhone) lineup, and continued strength in Apple's Services segment."
For the March quarter, Apple is expected to earn $2.70 a share, up 29% year over year, on sales of $61.19 billion, up 16%.
